decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (LP2003-FIRA-XX-XX-DR-LA-75613 Rev A; LP2003-FIRA-XX-XX-DR-LA-75614 Received: 09/11/2018) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - At the commencement of school holidays and half terms or at any time during those holiday periods, the pitch-side netting shall be lowered to a height of not more than two metres above ground level at its highest at the end of the last use of the pitch after each activity on the pitch where no proposed use of the pitch is to take place within the following 24 hours and the netting shall not be raised again until hour before the commencement of the next proposed use of the pitch.  At other times, the netting shall be lowered at the start of any period when it is not proposed to use the pitch for a period of one week or more and shall not be raised again until hour before the commencement of the next proposed use of the pitch.
Condition : 4 - No temporary or removable floodlighting shall be installed around the pitch.

Condition : 5 - Notwithstanding the details submitted on the approved drawings, the ball catch fencing shall be installed no further from the edge of the pitch than two metres and the ball catch netting shall have a mesh size with voids of not less than 120 mm.
description: Erection of 6 m high ball stop netting adjacent to proposed sports pitches.
